articles.summary: You may remember that on February 3, 2016, NYS Senator Schumer performed the 1 millionth hydrogen refueling from a Plug Power GenFuel dispenser. (Did you miss it? articles.title: 5M Hydrogen fuelings performed by material handling customers – no small feat, never done before, by anyone, anywhere.
